Fourth degree burns

Fourth degree burn

  • Injury through skin and subcutaneous fat into underlying muscle or bone

Fourth degree burn presentation

  • Involves structures beneath the skin including muscle and bone
  • Black charred with eschar
  • Dry

Fourth degree burn healing

  • Doesn’t heal, require excision
  • Amputation always required
  • Significant functional impairment and sometimes death
